comments.author: Hacker228
comments.body_html:
Hi! Yes, the mod only changes those parameters that are mentioned in the description. I used the values from patch 0.12, which were in the configs of earlier versions of SPT.

Source code with values and item IDs

// Define constant values const HEAT_FACTOR_BY_SHOT = 2.17; const HEAT_FACTOR_GUN = 0.98; const HEAT_FACTOR_AMMO_SP_5 = 1.273; const HEAT_FACTOR_AMMO_SP_6 = 1.34; const HEAT_FACTOR_AMMO_SPP = 1.206; // Define item IDs and names to update const itemsToUpdate = [ { id: “57838ad32459774a17445cd2”, name_gun: “VSS” }, { id: “57c44b372459772d2b39b8ce”, name_gun: “VAL” } ]; const ammoToUpdate = [ { id: “57a0dfb82459774d3078b56c”, heatFactor: HEAT_FACTOR_AMMO_SP_5, name_ammo: “SP-5” }, { id: “57a0e5022459774d1673f889”, heatFactor: HEAT_FACTOR_AMMO_SP_6, name_ammo: “SP-6” }, { id: “5c0d668f86f7747ccb7f13b2”, heatFactor: HEAT_FACTOR_AMMO_SPP, name_ammo: “SPP” } ];
